verdict.rationale: OpenClaw is fundamentally a built-in AI assistant reachable via chat channels, CLI, desktop apps and companion nodes, with delegation via skills, subagents, swarms, automations and standing orders — well documented and corroborated by community usage (e.g. running multiple agents, scheduling tasks). missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of assistant task-delegation quality/reliability beyond anecdotal HN comments, and some comments note mixed real-world success ('haven't found ANY uses for it where it actually did what it was supposed to do').
